g.text: MySQL 8.0.46 full backend physical ERD - REVIEW 2026-10-26
UUID = proposed CHAR(36) ascii_bin consistently on PK/FK.
UTC DATETIME(6), integer VND. Full columns/checks/indexes in database-schema.md.
Source contribution UNIQUE(source_transaction_id) spans BASE and ADJUSTMENT.
ERD alone does not enforce atomic fee/cycle/balance, temporal overlap or owner checks.
